_comment: Queries each wrapper must answer identically. holiday_entry returns the full stored entry for a date (null when none), so a wrapper that drops a field fails the diff. The check script runs these in Python, JavaScript, Rust, and Go, and diffs the outputs. Every is_open probe has an in_session twin (label in_session_<suffix>, same args) that must give the same answer: in_session is the any-session alias of the registry-level is_open (4d2); tools/cross_lang/check_in_session_twins.py checks it on every runner's output.
